environment: Same computer: a local classroom server and headless Chrome, 1366x768 with a keyboard and 1024x768 with a touch screen.
pass: no guided start and no walk-through: the first thing said is the arrival's tip ("Your family is on its way to its own land. When they get there, choose a house and set your family to work.")
on the land, how to give an order: "Tap one of your family on the left, then tap a job along the bottom to set them to it. “Idle” means they have nothing to do."

the house: "Press “Choose a house”, then set people to “Work on the house”. Where it needs logs, put one on “Fell trees” and turn on auto. Until it stands, the family camps." - and with the plan open, the tip waited behind it and came back when it closed

the field: "To farm, clear ground and set someone to “Plant the field”: corn feeds the family, cotton sells. Planting uses seed, and the crop takes time to ripen."; going to town: "“Go to town to trade” sends someone to the store to buy and sell. They are away from the farm for the trip, and coin spent is gone from your score."

the call's tip is on the screen: "Your settlement is calling for men: press the “!” and tick who goes. Each one leaves the farm with powder and the rifle. No answer in about 5 minutes, and the call closes." - above the bar, clear of the column and the guided start, 14px, and a click on its words reaches the map
the Host's page shows no tip
Escape put the tip away, and the server keeps it as seen
after a reload, with the call still open, its tip is not shown again

in the first hour, nothing says "Not yet": nursing the sick goes through, food goes through, enlisting only for its own reason ("Paz Proofwright is already nursing the sick."), the well only for its own reason ("Paz Proofwright is already nursing the sick.")

the order to leave: its tip ("Your family is told to leave. Press the “!”, choose what to load and press “Leave for the east”, or choose to stay. No answer in time, and the family packs and goes."), put away with a tap, and the "!" on the main person with "3 min" left on it

on the road: the route's tip ("On the road east: by the road is quicker, but soldiers see you from farther off. Across country is slower and harder to see. “Change where we go” changes it."), put away with a tap

¡Alto!: its tip ("Soldiers shout “¡Alto!”, which means “Halt!”. Press the “!” and answer fast: halting loses the wagon and goods, and running risks their shots. No answer means you halt."), the "!" with "30s" on it, put away with a tap
after a reload with the soldiers still waiting, none of the flight, the route or ¡Alto! is shown again (this page showed: enlist, order, flight, house, field, rest, route, road, star, alto)

farm.house: Press “Choose a house”, then set people to “Work on the house”. Where it needs logs, put one on “Fell trees” and turn on auto. Until it stands, the family camps.
farm.field: To farm, clear ground and set someone to “Plant the field”: corn feeds the family, cotton sells. Planting uses seed, and the crop takes time to ripen.
farm.town: “Go to town to trade” sends someone to the store to buy and sell. They are away from the farm for the trip, and coin spent is gone from your score.

call.text: Your settlement is calling for men: press the “!” and tick who goes. Each one leaves the farm with powder and the rifle. No answer in about 5 minutes, and the call closes.

enlisted.error: Paz Proofwright is already nursing the sick.

well.error: Paz Proofwright is already nursing the sick.

sick.text: Someone is sick, and resting helps them mend. Have another grown-up choose “Nurse the sick”: nobody dies while being nursed. A very sick person can die within a day.

tip.text: Your family is told to leave. Press the “!”, choose what to load and press “Leave for the east”, or choose to stay. No answer in time, and the family packs and goes.

flight.label: The family has been told to leave for the east. About 3 min left. Go to Gregorio Proofwright and answer.

route.text: On the road east: by the road is quicker, but soldiers see you from farther off. Across country is slower and harder to see. “Change where we go” changes it.

tip.text: Soldiers shout “¡Alto!”, which means “Halt!”. Press the “!” and answer fast: halting loses the wagon and goods, and running risks their shots. No answer means you halt.
